tabs.title: Description
tabs.html:
The Wi-Tek WI-AP317 outdoor wireless access point delivers reliable dual-band Wi-Fi connectivity with combined speeds up to 1200 Mbps. Supporting both Wi-Fi 5 and Wi-Fi 6 clients, this rugged outdoor AP is ideal for extending wireless coverage in outdoor environments including campuses, offices, retail areas, and outdoor venues. Built for durability and performance, it offers seamless connectivity across the 2.4 GHz and 5.8 GHz bands.


Features: 


  • Dual-Band Wireless: 2.4 GHz & 5.8 GHz
  • Combined Wireless Speed: Up to 1200 Mbps
  • Supports Wi-Fi 5 (802.11ac) and Wi-Fi 6 (802.11ax) clients
  • Outdoor-Rated Weatherproof Housing
  • Flexible Operation Modes: AP / Bridge / Repeater
  • High-Performance Antenna for Extended Coverage
  • Easy Deployment for Outdoor Wi-Fi Networks
